1. REMOVE the dark maroon cast shadow directly underneath the blue curtain's raised curved swag: the carpet area below the blue arc and above-left of the vertical hanging blue curtain panel must be normal bright RED carpet matching the surrounding lit floor. Preserve the blue fabric's own shading and silhouette perfectly. Specifically the broad dark maroon patch immediately BELOW the swag at crop x175..274, y109..168 must disappear completely.

opponent_details.prompt:

Photorealistic crisp pixel art. Make only these small fixes:
A) Stopwatch lanyard: LIGHTEN BOTH existing braided brown cords to match original warm medium brown (highlights RGB174,113,64; midtones129,85,44; deep shadows68,48,20), preserving the exact paths and fine braided texture. Do not add cord. On the watch's upper-left shoulder where cord terminates, restore a tiny STEEL METAL ATTACHMENT RING, mostly obscured by the cord but with a small silver crescent visible. At the right attachment, replace the incorrect gold socket/hole in the blue casing with a TINY STEEL METAL RING connecting cord to case: cord passes THROUGH THE RING, never into blue enamel. Right ring mostly hidden behind the cord, subtle gray metal visibility only.
B) Restore continuous yellow pencil between the two stopwatch push buttons: REMOVE ONLY the stray thin silver metal filament on the pencil immediately below the large angled top button and above the small horizontal right button. Keep both legitimate stopwatch buttons unchanged.
C) Add the two small dark graphite pencil-grade letters H and B, reading H then B from top to bottom, printed along the diagonal shaft immediately ABOVE its orange metal ferrule near lower right. Follow the pencil's existing angle. Small crisp legible dark letters, not broad text. They are present in original image 2.
D) Stopwatch main hands must faithfully follow original image 2. Keep their existing angles and pivot location, but make both shafts VERY THIN uniform needles, with SHORT WIDENED LEAF/SPADE portions ONLY NEAR THE VERY OUTER TIPS. Black hand points upper left, red hand upper right. Tips pointed, wide leaf occurs only within outermost quarter of each hand. Remaining three quarters down to the pivot a fine narrow shaft. Do not make whole hands thick. Do not move or redesign face, ticks, subdial or pivot.
E) On the cropped blue circular keyring emblem at bottom right, retain the D, fix S so its bottom curve is connected and fully visible as in image 2, and make the partial I to the right more visible. Exact white thin text DSI following the existing diagonal baseline; keep the emblem and keyring unchanged.
No changes to any other area. No additional metal, text, objects, buttons, grain, shadows, no crop or padding. Output exact same closeup framing.

The roof currently incorrectly shows seat/headrest silhouettes through the black panel. Remove all seats/interior/blue gaps and make it an OPAQUE BLACK SOLID ROOF. Preserve blue body, silver-gray edging, mirrors, road, and rear window with white lettering exactly. VERY IMPORTANT STYLE: traditional hand-placed LOW-RESOLUTION PIXEL ART, like the original Stunts menu and the surrounding car. Do NOT render a photograph. Do NOT paint smooth gradients or airbrushed highlights. The central surface is almost entirely a flat TRUE BLACK color, with only a restrained jagged charcoal highlight patch in the upper LEFT, corresponding to the original gray left roof shading in IMAGE 2. Build that highlight with only three or four discrete hard-edged DARK GRAY levels, in clear deliberate chunky angular PIXEL CLUSTERS. Sharp stair-step boundaries between flat shades. No subpixel antialiasing, no smooth gradient, no photographic surface, no blur, no random dithering. Keep crisp flat black and charcoal steps. This is a tiny roof-only edit, never generate a full menu. Same exact crop framing, no new objects, no margins.
